seo.title: Quyosh Energy — turnkey solar panels in Tashkent
seo.description: We design and install solar systems for homes, shops and factories: sizing, panels and inverters, grid connection and service. Engineer visits are free.
seo.answer: Quyosh Energy designs and installs turnkey solar systems in Tashkent and the region. A 5 kW home system starts at 38,000,000 UZS installed, a 10 kW system at 69,000,000 UZS; installation takes 2–4 days. The engineer visit and sizing are free, and our workmanship carries a 5-year warranty.

sections.title: Your roof can do the work
sections.eyebrow: Installing across Tashkent and the region
sections.subtitle: Solar systems for homes and businesses: we size the system, mount the panels and inverter, connect to the grid and service it. Daytime power, from the sun.

sections.label: About
sections.title: Engineers, not panel sellers
sections.text: Every system starts with a site visit: we check the roof, tree shade, the meter and the panel board. We size it to your real consumption, not to the maximum. The installation crew is our own staff; once running, the system shows up in an app and service visits once a year.

items.q: How long does a system take to pay off?
items.a: It depends on your tariff, consumption and how much power you use in the daytime. We calculate it in the quote from your actual bills, not from averages.
Yes, though output is lower because the days are short. The annual estimate accounts for every season.

items.q: What happens during a power cut?
items.a: A grid-tied inverter shuts off for safety. To keep the house running during outages you need a hybrid inverter and batteries.
Grid connection needs paperwork — we prepare and file it for you.
Pitched and flat roofs both work; orientation and shade matter. The engineer checks on the visit.
